title: Finnish Labour Temple
scope: The original 1910 Finnish Labour Temple at 314 Bay Street, with its entrance stairs, columned porch, polygonal center tower, intact cupola and original hall mass.
limitations: This is the early 1910 exterior. The original hall burned in December 2021 and its remains were cleared in 2022.
Rear elevation and roof transitions use the prefire outline with interpreted openings. Early masonry color, minor details and heights are estimated from archival prints.
